additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471633-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R1 170001369] Contactor issue CRM:03056000923
additional_info.body:
Hello Konrad,
Here is the possible troubleshooting for Api disconnect issue
Check network connectivity
Ethernet/LTE availability
Router/firewall rules blocking outbound traffic
Verify backend server status
OCCP/OCPI operator cloud online?
Certificates still valid?
Confirm configuration
Backend endpoint URL
Ports (often 443)
Auth
enticat
ion tokens
Reboot c
harger / communication module
Often resolves temporary API handshake failures.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.

additional_info.body:
Hi Konrad, good morning.
Apologies for the confusion, I checked the time you provided and found that we lost communication to the EcoG from PLC side.
As such, no sessions were able to start until most likely a reboot.
There is no contactor issue as I checked from the past week.
I've checked via AWS and found that after the 7/Jan this error never happened again:
Please let me know what you need from my side, because from my perspective the error is no longer present and doesn't need to be checked on-site.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
